subcategory_text: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained
informative_references: CRI Profile v2.0: GV.RM-02, GV.RM-02.01, GV.RM-02.02, GV.RM-02.03
implementation_examples: Determine and communicate risk appetite statements that convey expectations about the appropriate level of risk for the organization
Translate risk appetite statements into specific, measurable, and broadly understandable risk tolerance statements
Refine organizational objectives and risk appetite periodically based on known risk exposure and residual risk
assessment_objectives: Determine whether risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that determine and communicate risk appetite statements that convey expectations about the appropriate level of risk for the organization.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that translate risk appetite statements into specific, measurable, and broadly understandable risk tolerance statements.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
